title: `set_html` builds markup from an interpolated value in frontend/app.howl
summary: A call to `set_html` assembles HTML containing an interpolated value and no escape function appears in the surrounding expression.
recommended_remediation: Route every interpolated value through the artifact's escape function, or set text content instead of markup.

reproduction.summary: Re-read the source and match the same construction.
